texts.preamble: Dharmendra Kumar Gupta vs State Of U.P. And Another on 27 January, 2025 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:14108 Court No. - 77 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 35035 of 2024 Applicant :- Dharmendra Kumar Gupta Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ravi Ratn Kumar Sinha Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J. 1.
texts.facts: 3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that a sample of mustard oil was collected from the shop of the applicant on 06.03.2010. Thereafter, on the basis of report of Food Analyst, F.I.R. was registered on 08.03.2010 against the applicant u/s 272 I.P.C. Thereafter, applicant also remained in jail for about 7 months in that case. It is further submitted that apart from lodging the F.I.R., a complaint u/s 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act was also filed against the Dharmendra Kumar Gupta vs State Of U.P. And Another on 27 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93980339/ 1 applicant which is still pending for more than 14 years.
texts.arguments: It is further submitted that the applicant cannot be punished for one offence in two different cases which is in violation of Section 300 Cr.P.C. as well as Article 20 of the Constitution of India. 4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. submitted that the impugned complaint was filed in the year 2010 at the time of lodging the F.I.R. against the applicant and the applicant has approached this Court after almost 15 years and therefore, he is not entitled to any relief. 5. Considering the aforesaid submissions and taking into account that the applicant has already remained in jail for 7 months in pursuance of the F.I.R. dated 08.03.2010 in Case Crime No. 792 of 2010 u/s 272 I.P.C. on the basis of adulterated sample of mustard oil and impugned proceeding is also based on the same cause of action. The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Ram Nath Singh Vs. State of U.P., (2024) SCC Online SC 177 has observed that in the case of offence u/s Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, a person cannot be prosecuted and punished under the provision of I.P.C. for the same cause of action.
texts.petitioner_arguments: It is further submitted that the applicant cannot be punished for one offence in two different cases which is in violation of Section 300 Cr.P.C. as well as Article 20 of the Constitution of India. 4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. submitted that the impugned complaint was filed in the year 2010 at the time of lodging the F.I.R. against the applicant and the applicant has approached this Court after almost 15 years and therefore, he is not entitled to any relief. 5. Considering the aforesaid submissions and taking into account that the applicant has already remained in jail for 7 months in pursuance of the F.I.R. dated 08.03.2010 in Case Crime No. 792 of 2010 u/s 272 I.P.C. on the basis of adulterated sample of mustard oil and impugned proceeding is also based on the same cause of action.
texts.other_lawyer_arguments: The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Ram Nath Singh Vs. State of U.P., (2024) SCC Online SC 177 has observed that in the case of offence u/s Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, a person cannot be prosecuted and punished under the provision of I.P.C. for the same cause of action.
